verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a public REST v3 API for building custom integrations and automating workspace workflows. It has endpoint-level docs for create, delete and list operations, versioning guidance, parameter semantics, and claimed Swagger/OpenAPI machine-readable specs. The probes that 404'd only tried guessed spec paths; they do not concretely contradict the documented API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, a confirmed reachable OpenAPI spec location, and documented auth or rate-limit details in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use this API to build custom integrations or automate even more of your workspace’s workflow.
Create Category allows you to create a new Category in Shortcut.
We provide machine-readable versions of our API specified in Swagger and OpenAPI.
To update, simply change the `/v2/` in your URL paths to `/v3/`.
